title: Ingredient, Cultivation & Foodcraft source reconciliation crosswalk

Items.csv.role: mostly finished items/consumables and alchemical outputs; not a primary ingredient catalog

Bases_Facilities.csv.role: facilities, agriculture/foraging outputs and a small normalized agricultural-material subset

Profession_Crafting_Abilities.csv.role: ability/perk rules and progression, not ingredient identity

cooking_rarity.source_rule: ingredient rarity chart; examples include common vegetables/grains/basic meat, uncommon Frostberries/Dragonfruit/Basilisk Eggs, rare Phoenix Feathers/Chrono-Crystals/Voidfruit

known_conflicts.conflict: Legendary vs Exotic vs Supernatural are used as top-level/source classifications and cannot be assumed equivalent.
known_conflicts.rule: preserve source value and map into a new canonical vocabulary only through an explicit mapping
do not silently choose either value; retain both provenance-scoped assertions

sources.Bases_Facilities.csv: credits or MC with inferred annotations
sources.MIB-13: explicit versioned in-game currency definitions and market-context prices

known_conflicts.rule: legacy costs are source observations, not universal canonical prices
retain source unit text now; later bind production to typed ingredient/material stable IDs instead of generic untyped units

facility_and_husbandry_seams.name: Animal Pen
facility_and_husbandry_seams.output: weekly meat, milk, wool, or leather

facility_and_husbandry_seams.name: Animal Pen (Homesteading Facility Reference List)
facility_and_husbandry_seams.output: 5 Food and 2 Material Units per week

creature_harvest_seam.source_rule: creature records include biology and loot or harvest references where authored
creature_harvest_seam.icf_rule: ICF may crosswalk authored harvest references to canonical ingredient/material definitions but must record missing anatomy/harvest evidence as a gap instead of fabricating it

MIB-12.relevance: explicit recipes and owner-domain Asset outputs provide the deterministic crafting boundary ICF recipes/processing must later use

MIB-13.relevance: legacy ingredient values become market-context economy metadata, not global truth; independent markets may value the same ingredient differently

icf02_open_decisions: canonical rarity/tier vocabulary and provenance-preserving source mappings
stable-ID naming and alias rules including singular/plural and spacing variants
separation of rarity, supernatural classification, availability and market scarcity
canonical unit vocabulary and conversion policy
value metadata model compatible with MIB-13 market-context prices
primary ingredient versus derived preparation boundary
culinary vs magical-culinary vs alchemical property namespaces
source-derived versus governed first-party authoring status
coverage-gap lifecycle for unsupported creature anatomy/harvest lore
completion_rule: This crosswalk is reconciliation evidence only. It intentionally does not assign final canonical ingredient IDs, canonical rarity values, inferred creature parts, or normalized universal prices; those are ICF-02 or later decisions.
